description: dispatcher/messages.json: the words of the dispatcher's own refusals, and of the errors it writes into a job.

refusals.description: Each refusal the dispatcher makes itself, on the operation's failure channel.

operation.description: The operation it refuses: a request of bus/registry.json's operations that the dispatcher answers.

situation.description: When it is written, and what fills each `{name}` of its text.

message.description: The failure's `message`. A `{name}` in it is filled with what the row's `situation` names, and nothing else in it varies.

errors.description: Each error the dispatcher writes into a job on its own, as a `job:fail` would.

situation.description: When it is written, and what fills each `{name}` of its text.

error.description: The `error` it writes into the job. A `{name}` in it is filled with what the row's `situation` names, and nothing else in it varies.
